description: Zenith file.read: read at most 16384 bytes of one regular file under an allowlisted prefix, refusing symlink escapes and secret-like names. Read-only. Output format zenith.file.read/v1 (content is base64).

path.description: Absolute path under an allowed prefix; no '..'.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to read; the document clamps it to 16384.

executionTimeout.description: Seconds before the command is considered failed (1-999).

runCommand: [ -n "$path" ] || die 64 'parameter path is empty (SSM Agent >= 3.3.2746.0 is required for ENV_VAR parameters)'
case "$path" in /*) ;; *) die 64 'path must be absolute' ;; esac
case "$path" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._@:+=,/-]*) die 64 'path contains forbidden characters' ;; esac
case "$path" in *..*) die 65 'path may not contain ..' ;; esac

deny() { l=$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); case "$l" in *.pem|*.key|*.pfx|*.p12|*id_rsa*|*id_ed25519*|*.env|*/.env*|*/.ssh/*|*/.aws/*|*/.kube/*|*/.docker/*|*/shadow*|*/gshadow*|*/sudoers*|*credentials*|*secret*|/proc/*|/sys/*|/dev/*) return 0 ;; esac; return 1; }
deny "$path" && die 65 'path matches a never-readable pattern'
command -v readlink >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 69 'readlink is not available on this machine'
deny "$resolved" && die 65 'path resolves to a never-readable pattern'
[ "$ok" = 1 ] || die 65 'path is not under an allowed prefix'
if [ "$size" -gt "$maxb" ]; then echo 'truncated=true'; else echo 'truncated=false'; fi
